environment.scope: Default study package environment only. Per-configuration declared_environment and toolchain commands override native-toolkit defaults; verify per-run snapshots before release comparisons.

implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Complex convolution resampling of a regular 64×64 image at 64 irregular points, using an 8×8 subpixel table of 32×32 complex kernels and zero extension outside the image. Each point has 32 lane-wise x contributions and a 32-lane sum reduction.
implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: Native/CUDA.jl 32×8 threads and two blocks; each warp processes four points. Native warp shuffle tree uses no shared memory. KA/JACC emulate the same lane dataflow using 512 Float64 shared slots and 44 block barriers per block.
compute_precision: Float32 coordinate floor and sub-bin conversion

reference_repair.finding: Historical CUDA.jl already implements the complex convolution and native warp reduction. It uses Float64 floor/bins instead of native floorf, guards image loads before bounds rather than using padded source storage, and sorts by kernel sub-bin order rather than the native swapped-axis locality key. These are precision/input/memory mapping differences, not evidence of a wrong configured scientific operator. Named adapter aligns Float32 floorf and fully initialized padded storage.
reference_repair.named_configuration: Guarded-header macros NPOINTS64 IMG_SIZE64 GCF_DIM32 REPEAT3; GCF_GRID8 and 32×8 source geometry retained. Two generated dyadic fixtures replace source default random/transcendental inputs.
reference_repair.point_sort_scope: Named comparator uses floor fractions and swapped-axis key. It agrees with source modf comparator for nonnegative points, but differs for negative coordinates included here. The study_common source comment about native ordering is qualified by this statement. All four consume the same complete serialized ordered point list.

scientific_intent.scope: Complex local resampling, not a complete Fourier transform, adjoint identity, astronomical data validation, or imaging pipeline. Dyadic Float32-representable coordinates and exact scaled-integer coefficients; broader Float64 binning and ill-conditioned coefficient accuracy are unmeasured.
